essay.instruction: SECTION B - ANSWER TWO QUESTIONS. SECTION C - ANSWER TWO QUESTIONS.

questions.question:
a. What is partnership?
b. List three types of partners.
c. List four conditions to be followed in the absence of partnership deed. (15 marks)

a. What is not-for-profit making organization?
b. Outline two differences between a for-profit making organization and a not-for-profit making organization.
c. Explain the following sources of funding in a non-profit making organization:
   i. Subscription
   ii. Life membership fee
   iii. Entrance fee
   iv. Donation
(WAEC 2020)

Explain the following:
a. Certificate of incorporation
b. Prospectus
c. Quoted company
d. Company limited by share
e. Articles of Association
(15 marks)

The books of Omiye Social Club showed the following information for the year ended 31st December, 2015. Use the Receipts and Payments Account, opening balances and additional information shown below.

You are required to prepare:
a. Income and Expenditure Account for the year ended 31st December, 2015.
b. Balance Sheet as at that date.
(15 marks) (WAEC SSCE 2020)

Ubochi and Hassana started a partnership business on 1st January, 2015. They contributed D300,000 and D250,000 respectively as capital. Their partnership deed stated that:
• Interest of 8% should be paid on capital per annum.
• Hassana would be paid D10,000 monthly as salary.
• Interest on drawings is 5%.
• The profits are to be shared in the ratio 3:2 respectively.

At the end of the year, the profit made was D300,000. During the period, Ubochi and Hassana made drawings of D20,000 and D15,000 respectively.

You are required to prepare:
a. Profit and Loss Appropriation Account for the year ended 31st December, 2015.
b. Partners’ Current Account.
(15 marks) (WAEC 2019)

Ibrahim John runs a restaurant business from his apartment. He does not keep proper accounting records. The following information was extracted from his notebook, cheque stubs and discussions with him, as shown below.

You are required to prepare:
a. Opening and closing Statement of Affairs.
b. Profit or Loss Statement for the year ended 31st December, 2006.
c. Balance Sheet as at that date.
(15 marks) (WAEC GCE 2007)
